prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Shortcut Reference Sheet: Add a new onboarding screen right after home intro summarizing keyboard and mouse shortcuts for controlling the pet. (why: Support received multiple emails about confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, and finish completion is only 64.8%.)
1: [home, redesign] Waiting Room Tip Carousel Spotlight: Redesign the waiting screen into a spotlight layout featuring interactive tip carousels about desktop pet controls and active progress indicators. (why: Home median time is 201s with drop-offs occurring while pet generation renders. Providing useful tips keeps users engaged during waiting.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Photo Live Validation Flow: Introduce a new verification screen before generating a custom pet that displays a live animated preview of how the photo maps to the pet model. (why: Support reported 3 emails regarding custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, causing drop-offs during adoption.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Account Save Protection Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly inform users that signing in saves pet progress across sessions and avoids pet resets. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account save protection critical at sign-in step.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Rendering Progress Indicator: Add detailed stage status text and desktop ready notification options on the waiting screen while the pet model renders on screen. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not appearing on desktop after waiting, and waiting time has high median duration (201s).)
5: [choose_path, hint] Path Selector Adoption Speed Hint: Add a hint beneath path selection options highlighting that preset companions launch instantly while custom pets take under 2 minutes. (why: choose_path drop-off leaves 23.8% behind with high mean duration (514s); clear timing expectations prevent hesitation.)
6: [finish, notification] Desktop Active Layer Visibility Banner: Add a prompt and status badge on home_intro confirming that the pet is running on top of open desktop windows. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not showing on desktop or app not opening after completing setup.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Hero Full Bleed Layout: Change the initial story screen layout to full bleed with an engaging mascot asset and prominent adoption journey call to action. (why: choose_path step takes long mean duration (514s) and story engagement can be improved with a high-impact intro visual.)
